title: As if it wasn’t broken already
html_source: A third iteration of a broken heart in this chapter. First, Mr Cunningham’s observation that Paddy Dignam’s cause of death was a breakdown of the heart. Second, Bloom’s mental echo of the phrase just before seeing the child’s coffin pass by the carriage. Now, Bloom thinks of his father’s broken heart.
